result.title: JAVIS: Joint Audio-Visual Interaction and Streaming for Real-Time Conversational Agents
result.summary: Human communication is inherently multimodal, conveying intent not only through linguistic and vocal cues but also through visual signals. However, existing conversational systems have mainly focused on text or speech, leaving out the visual feedback that is essential for natural interaction. In this paper, we propose JAVIS, an end-to-end streaming framework for real-time audio-visual conversational agents. Our key idea is to let the voice and the face speak from a single representation. On top of a shared LLM, a Joint Refined Head produces a unified audio-visual representation, which is fed into dedicated streaming branches for speech and face generation. This end-to-end design avoids intermediate bottlenecks, enabling real-time generation while keeping speech and face tightly synchronized. In addition, we present JAVIS-Syn, a 334-hour synthetic corpus designed to address the lack of expressive audio-visual dialogue data, covering emotionally rich multi-turn conversations and assistant-style exchanges. Experiments show that JAVIS achieves approximately 200$\times$ lower initial latency than a strong baseline, while outperforming baselines in lip synchronization and facial expression appropriateness.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 JAVIS，一个端到端流式音频-视觉对话框架：在共享 LLM 上以 Joint Refined Head 生成统一的音频-视觉表示，再分流到语音与面部生成分支以降低时延并保持口型同步，同时发布 334 小时合成对话语料 JAVIS-Syn。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作面向实时语音与说话人脸生成，未涉及 VLM 推理中的内部视觉状态、证据获取、停止决策或 latent 轨迹，其共享表示也只服务于生成同步，缺少与 LVR 主线的实质联系。
